No URLs or public internet addresses (grep https?://|www.|.com: exit 1), so Colderwater lesson 13 does not arise in the brief. No author asides; the only meta text is requester-voiced ('Before you hand it over, please check it yourself...' instruction.md:13, the Colderwater lesson-5 line, which is a natural request, not a pasted note). Contradiction sweep: (a) accounts: instruction.md:19 lists 3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates; seed users exactly match emails and roles (USR-REC1..3, USR-MGR1..3, USR-OBS1, USR-CAN1..3); password Hireops!2026 identical in instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11. (b) seed path: /assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:15, integration.md:7, hireops_rules.md:215 - one path. (c) update interval: 'fifteen seconds' instruction.md:5 and '15 seconds' hireops_rules.md:123. (d) page size 30 hireops_rules.md:151,218 equals seed thread_page_size 30; 'one conversation is long' matches APP-101 with 120 messages; 'three jobs' matches 3 jobs; stage order and candidate wording table hireops_rules.md:191-198 match seed stages and candidate_status_labels. (e) runtime: port 3000/PORT, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, health route agree across instruction.md:15, integration.md:5-10 and hireops_rules.md:207-211; 'never touches the database' (brief) is a stricter, compatible form of 'answers before database work can block startup' (template paragraph). The rules' 'sometimes on a writable copy of the folder' (hireops_rules.md:208) agrees with integration.md:16-23 and with test.sh (cp -a /app/. to a copy, DB_PATH set). (f) undo: brief 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is refined, not contradicted, by hireops_rules.md:101-104 (move/re-order/reject/reopen invalidate; a note does not). Deterministic overlap applied by hand: instruction.md is 665 words (>= 40) with no draft markers (check-instruction-content behaviour); no grader vocabulary or placeholders (part of check-instruction-hygiene behaviour).
